51514129.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal His-tagged recombinant ZIKV ZG-01 RdRp (272 to 903 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli rosetta by surface plasmon resonance assay
51514129.references_previous: Z. He, X. Zhu, W. Wen, J. Yuan, Y. Hu, J. Chen, S. An, X. Dong, C. Lin, J. Yu, J. Wu, Y. Yang, J. Cai, J. Li, M. Li, Dengue virus subverts host innate immunity by targeting adaptor protein MAVS, J. Virol. 90 (2016) 7219–7230.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.2.4. BIACore a: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed in a BIACore T100 device (BIACore Inc., Uppsala, Sweden) using CM5 sensor chips (General Electric Company, GE) according to the protocol provided by the manufacturer. Briefly, recombinant RdRp protein was immobilized on a CM5 chip respectively. Different concentrations of 38, NITD008 or Ribavirin were injected at a flow rate of 30 μL/min for 5 min. Subsequently, data were collected for a 3-min association followed by a 20-min dissociation. The chip was regenerated by injecting 10 μL of 15 mM NaOH for 20 s. All procedures were run in 1% DMSO PBS-P20 (GE) as a running buffer. The binding kinetics was analyzed with the software BIAevaluation Version 3.1 using a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The Kd was calculated as previously described [47].
original_paragraph.Figure 6 caption: Fig. 6. Affinity analysis for 38 with ZIKV RdRp. (A) Schematic diagram of the RdRp expression vectors. (B) SPR assay to examine and characterize the binding of 38 or Ribavirin to ZIKV RdRp, using a BIACore T100 system. ZIKV RdRp protein was immobilized on a CM5 chip, respectively. The analytes were consisting of serial dilutions of 38, NITD008 or Ribavirin as indicated. The Kd values presented in B–D were calculated via the BIACore T100 analysis software (BIAevaluation Version 3.1).
original_paragraph.Figure 6B sensorgram data: The sensorgram in Figure 6B shows response units (y-axis) over time (x-axis, 0 to 250 s). The curves are labeled with concentrations of compound 38: 1.25 μM, 2.5 μM, 5 μM, 10 μM, and 20 μM. The Kd value is explicitly labeled on the graph as Kd = 1.87 μM.
original_paragraph.Figure 6C sensorgram data: The sensorgram in Figure 6C shows response units (y-axis) over time (x-axis, 0 to 250 s). The curves are labeled with concentrations of NITD008: 10 μM, 20 μM, 30 μM, 40 μM, and 50 μM. The Kd value is explicitly labeled on the graph as Kd = 3.43 μM.
original_paragraph.Figure 6D sensorgram data: The sensorgram in Figure 6D shows response units (y-axis) over time (x-axis, 0 to 250 s). The curves are labeled with concentrations of Ribavirin: 20 μM, 30 μM, 40 μM, 50 μM, and 30 μM (a second 30 μM curve is shown, possibly for comparison). The graph shows very low response units, indicating weak binding.
original_paragraph.Results section - SPR assay: We prepared a truncated NS5 containing only the RdRp domain without the MTase domain (Fig. 6A). These ZIKV RNA polymerase were produced in Escherichia coli and were used for subsequent experiments. Our results of SPR assay using the BIACore analysis showed that 38 directly bound ZIKV RdRp domain (Kd value = 1.87 μM) (Fig. 6B), which is similar to NITD008 (Kd value = 3.43 μM) (Fig. 6C), while only very weak interaction was shown between RdRp domain with Ribavirin (Fig. 6D). Notably, the binding between Ribavirin and the RdRp protein was weak, further suggesting the interaction between 38 and RdRp.

immobilization.ligand_name: recombinant ZIKV ZG-01 RdRp (272 to 903 residues)

analyte.concentration_range: 38: 1.25 μM - 20 μM; NITD008: 10 μM - 50 μM; Ribavirin: 20 μM - 50 μM
